usage: The word "藍牙" (laam4 ngaa4) is a noun and refers to the wireless technology standard Bluetooth.
It is commonly used before devices to describe wireless connection features, e.g., 藍牙耳機 (bluetooth earphones).
You can use it as a subject, object, or modifier in a sentence related to connectivity or electronic gadgets.
The term does not change form for singular or plural usage; context will indicate quantity.
It is mostly used in casual or technical conversations when referring to device communication.
